titles.en: Five Coins and a Dangerous Road

continuity.opening: Fire Eater rewards Pinocchio's courage with five gold coins intended for Geppetto.
continuity.closing: Pinocchio hangs helpless in the storm as someone in the Fairy's white house finally sends help.
continuity.next: The blue-haired Fairy will rescue Pinocchio and ask him to tell the truth about the missing coins.

learningObjective: Distinguish persuasive promises from trustworthy evidence while narrating mounting suspense with restraint.

beats.title: Five Golden Promises
beats.purpose: Give the coins an emotional purpose before the swindlers appear.

beats.title: The Field of Wonders
beats.purpose: Show how flattery and an easy miracle defeat an honest warning.

beats.title: The Red Lobster Inn
beats.purpose: Use sly comedy to reveal who benefits from the supposed friendship.

beats.title: The Bill and the Warning
beats.purpose: Let evidence accumulate while pride keeps Pinocchio moving forwards.

beats.title: Assassins on the Road
beats.purpose: Transform the friendly strangers into a fast, recognisable threat.

beats.title: The Silent White House
beats.purpose: Offer visible safety, then delay it to deepen suspense.

beats.title: The Great Oak
beats.purpose: Present the cliffhanger solemnly without graphic detail.

beats.title: A Light Behind the Shutter
beats.purpose: Turn wealth into regret and reveal that rescue has begun.
